---
title: ""
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    toc: false
    theme: none
    minimal: true
---

<style>
@font-face {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible";
  font-weight: 400;
  src: url("fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-latin-400-normal.woff2") format("woff2");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible";
  font-weight: 700;
  src: url("fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-latin-700-normal.woff2") format("woff2");
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --navy:  #1f335e;
  --blue:  #003cb3;
  --orange: #ff9100;
  --muted: #f0f4fa;
  --border: #c6d2e8;
  --text:  #222832;
  --small: #555;
}

@page { size: letter; margin: 0.45in 0.5in; }

body {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 8.4pt;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--text);
  background: #fff;
  max-width: 7.5in;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.3in 0;
}

/* ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

.handout-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1em;
  padding-bottom: 0.5em;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--orange);
  margin-bottom: 0.7em;
}

.handout-header img { height: 38px; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }

.handout-header-text h1 {
  font-size: 13pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0;
}

.handout-header-text p {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  color: var(--small);
  margin-top: 0.15em;
}

/* ── Body grid ────────────────────────────────────────── */

.handout-body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 55% 1fr;
  gap: 1.4em;
}

/* ── Section headings ─────────────────────────────────── */

.section-label {
  font-size: 7pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--navy);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--navy);
  padding-bottom: 0.2em;
  margin-bottom: 0.55em;
}

/* ── Project entries (left column) ───────────────────── */

.project-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55em; }

.project-entry {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.6em;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.project-accent {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  align-self: stretch;
  min-height: 2.4em;
}

.project-body {}

.project-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 8.4pt;
}

.project-origin {
  font-size: 7pt;
  color: var(--small);
  margin-top: 0.05em;
}

.project-desc {
  font-size: 8pt;
  margin-top: 0.1em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── Also-from list ───────────────────────────────────── */

.also-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3em;
  margin-top: 0.55em;
}

.also-badge {
  background: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.15em 0.45em;
  font-size: 7pt;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ── Right column panels ──────────────────────────────── */

.right-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.7em; }

.panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.panel-head {
  background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 7pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.3em 0.6em;
}

.panel-body {
  padding: 0.5em 0.6em;
  background: #fff;
}

.panel-body p, .panel-body li { font-size: 8pt; line-height: 1.4; }

.stat-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 0.3em;
}

.stat-num {
  font-size: 16pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--orange);
  line-height: 1;
}

.stat-label { font-size: 7.5pt; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.3; }

.stat-divider {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin: 0.35em 0;
}

.campus-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25em;
  margin-top: 0.25em;
}

.campus-chip {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.12em 0.4em;
  font-size: 6.8pt;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.area-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.35em;
  margin-bottom: 0.2em;
}

.area-icon { color: var(--orange); flex-shrink: 0; }

.area-text strong { color: var(--navy); }

.resource-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 0.2em;
  font-size: 7.8pt;
}

.resource-file {
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 7.2pt;
  background: var(--muted);
  color: var(--navy);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.learn-link {
  display: block;
  font-size: 8pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-bottom: 0.2em;
}

.learn-link:hover { color: var(--orange); }

/* ── Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

.handout-footer {
  margin-top: 0.7em;
  padding-top: 0.4em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 6.8pt;
  color: var(--small);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

@media print {
  body { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  a { color: var(--blue) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
  .learn-link { color: var(--blue) !important; }
}
</style>

<!-- HEADER -->
<div class="handout-header">
  <img src="images/uc-ospo-network-logo.svg" alt="UC OSPO Network">
  <div class="handout-header-text">
    <h1>UC Open Source as Institutional Infrastructure</h1>
    <p>Tim Dennis &middot; Data Science Center, UCLA Library &middot; IASSIST 2026 &middot; Slides + resources: <strong>ucospo.net</strong></p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- BODY -->
<div class="handout-body">

<!-- LEFT: Project origin stories -->
<div class="left-col">

<div class="section-label">From Dissertation to Global Infrastructure</div>

<div class="project-list">

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">BSD Unix</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Berkeley &middot; 1970s&ndash;80s</div>
      <div class="project-desc">The permissive licensing model that made open source possible. Derivatives (MIT, Apache) now govern billions of lines of production software worldwide.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">UCSC Genome Browser</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Santa Cruz &middot; Summer 2000</div>
      <div class="project-desc">PhD student Jim Kent assembled the human genome on 50 borrowed PCs, icing his wrists to keep coding. He finished <strong>three days before</strong> Celera Genomics and its dedicated supercomputer. The genome stayed in the public domain.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">Ceph</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Santa Cruz &middot; 2004</div>
      <div class="project-desc">Sage Weil&rsquo;s PhD dissertation on exabyte-scale distributed storage. Merged into the Linux kernel (2010); commercialized through Red Hat acquisition (2014). Proceeds funded <strong>CROSS at UCSC</strong>&mdash;the first UC OSPO and the seed of this network.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">Apache Spark</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Berkeley AMPLab &middot; 2009</div>
      <div class="project-desc">Matei Zaharia built it so a classmate could beat the Netflix Prize with faster distributed ML. Donated to Apache before commercializing. <strong>Databricks: $60B+.</strong></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">RISC-V</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Berkeley &middot; 2010</div>
      <div class="project-desc">A three-month summer project to give grad students a chip architecture without paying ARM royalties. Now in <strong>10 billion devices</strong>, adopted by 350+ organizations in 70 countries. Foundation relocated to Switzerland in 2020 to stay neutral in US-China trade tensions.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name">Ray</div>
      <div class="project-origin">UC Berkeley RISELab &middot; 2016</div>
      <div class="project-desc">Two PhD students tired of rewriting Python every time they needed to scale beyond one machine. Now <strong>core OpenAI compute infrastructure</strong>. Donated to the Linux Foundation in 2025.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div style="margin-top:0.6em;">
  <div class="section-label" style="font-size:6.5pt;">Also from UC campuses</div>
  <div class="also-list">
    <span class="also-badge">Jupyter (UCB)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">Processing (UCLA)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">tz database (UCLA)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">Named Data Networking (UCLA)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">Cytoscape (UCSD)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">EEGLAB (UCSD)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">UCSD Pascal</span>
    <span class="also-badge">ChimeraX (UCSF)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">OpenMM (UCSF)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">sourmash (UC Davis)</span>
    <span class="also-badge">ERPLAB (UC Davis)</span>
  </div>
  <p style="font-size:6.8pt; color:#777; margin-top:0.3em;">The pattern is not rare or accidental. &ldquo;The students writing their class projects this very semester may be creating the next Ray.&rdquo; &mdash; Nithya Ruff, UC Open Summit 2026</p>
</div>

</div><!-- end left-col -->

<!-- RIGHT: Network + stats + resources -->
<div class="right-col">

  <!-- Network overview -->
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="panel-head">The UC OSPO Network</div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-num">6</div>
        <div class="stat-label">UC campuses &middot; launched April 2024<br>Funded by Alfred P. Sloan Foundation</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-num">$1.85M</div>
        <div class="stat-label">in external funding to date</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-num">280K+</div>
        <div class="stat-label">students &middot; 25,000+ faculty served</div>
      </div>
      <hr class="stat-divider">
      <div class="campus-chips">
        <span class="campus-chip">Santa Cruz</span>
        <span class="campus-chip">Berkeley</span>
        <span class="campus-chip">Davis</span>
        <span class="campus-chip">Los Angeles</span>
        <span class="campus-chip">Santa Barbara</span>
        <span class="campus-chip">San Diego</span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:6.8pt; color:#777; margin-top:0.35em;">Lead: UCSC, first OSPO in a large state university system. Part of <strong>CURIOSS</strong> (34 academic OSPOs worldwide).</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Survey findings -->
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="panel-head">What We Found (2025 survey, n=294)</div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-num">52K</div>
        <div class="stat-label">institutionally affiliated repos scanned across 10 UC campuses</div>
      </div>
      <hr class="stat-divider">
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-num">58%</div>
        <div class="stat-label">of UC OSS contributors are also <em>maintainers</em>&mdash;not just users, but stewards</div>
      </div>
      <hr class="stat-divider">
      <p style="font-size:7.8pt; margin-bottom:0.2em;"><strong>#1 challenge:</strong> finding time to write documentation</p>
      <p style="font-size:7.8pt;"><strong>Nationally (Tidelift 2024):</strong> 60% of maintainers are unpaid &middot; 43% report burnout</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Three areas -->
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="panel-head">Three Focus Areas</div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <div class="area-row">
        <div class="area-icon">&#128301;</div>
        <div class="area-text"><strong>Discovery</strong> &mdash; UC Open Repository Browser (UC ORB); GitHub pipeline + system-wide survey</div>
      </div>
      <div class="area-row">
        <div class="area-icon">&#127807;</div>
        <div class="area-text"><strong>Sustainability</strong> &mdash; Cross-campus licensing WG (UCOP + tech transfer); OSSPREY project health; community management</div>
      </div>
      <div class="area-row">
        <div class="area-icon">&#128214;</div>
        <div class="area-text"><strong>Education</strong> &mdash; Curriculum inventory at ucospo.net/education; Carpentries + CodeRefinery + UC-specific content</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Resources -->
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="panel-head">Resources for Your Researchers</div>
    <div class="panel-body">
      <div class="resource-row"><span class="resource-file">README.md</span> template + guide (Laura Langdon, UC OSPO)</div>
      <div class="resource-row"><span class="resource-file">LICENSE</span> guide with UC-approved options</div>
      <div class="resource-row"><span class="resource-file">CONTRIBUTING.md</span> template + guide</div>
      <div class="resource-row"><span class="resource-file">CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md</span> Contributor Covenant + guidance</div>
      <div class="resource-row"><span class="resource-file">CITATION.cff</span> + Zenodo release &rarr; citable, versioned DOI</div>
      <p style="font-size:6.8pt; color:#777; margin-top:0.3em;">All at <strong>ucospo.net/oss-resources</strong> &middot; Published Sept 2025</p>
    </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div><!-- end right-col -->
